note.zh-TW: 課程的門檻是經驗值，只當「課程參考值」顯示，不計分；流動負債為 0 時比率沒有定義，網站顯示 N/A，不顯示無限大。
note.en: The course threshold is a rule of thumb, shown only as a course reference value and not scored; when current liabilities are nil the ratio is undefined, so the site shows N/A rather than infinity.

definition.zh-TW:
一年內會變成現金的流動資產，是一年內要償還的流動負債的幾倍。

它是最常用的短期償債能力指標：倍數越高，短期內周轉不過來的風險越低。
definition.en:
How many times the current assets that will turn into cash within a year cover the current liabilities due within a year.

It is the most common measure of short-term solvency: the higher the multiple, the lower the risk of a cash squeeze.

example.zh-TW: 兩個數字都在資產負債表上。流動負債為 0 時比率沒有定義，網站顯示 N/A 並說明「目前沒有流動負債」，不顯示無限大。課程的門檻只當參考值顯示，常見的經驗值有兩倍或一倍半，都不計分。
example.en: Both figures are on the balance sheet. When current liabilities are zero the ratio is undefined; the site shows N/A with the note that there are no current liabilities rather than infinity. The course threshold is shown as a reference value only; common rules of thumb are two times or one and a half times, and none of them is scored.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為流動比率越高越好。流動資產裡可能塞滿賣不掉的存貨或收不回的帳款，比率高不代表隨時有現金；所以要再看速動比率與現金流量比率。
misconception.en: Assuming a higher current ratio is always better. Current assets may be stuffed with unsaleable inventory or uncollectable receivables, so a high ratio does not guarantee ready cash; check the quick ratio and cash flow ratio as well.

formula.zh-TW: 流動比率的算法：流動資產 ÷ 流動負債。
formula.en: Current ratio = current assets ÷ current liabilities.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率，這個名稱是國際通用的說法；計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準，題目會指定用哪一個版本計分。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios; the name follows international usage. The calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry, and each question states which version it scores against.
